cases.title: A looping task is stopped, retried, and the run finishes
steps: Write the fake script {"task:2":{"attempts":[{"loop":8}]}} as TESTING.md describes
Run the diamond fixture with --provider fake and that script (terminal, tmux)
cases.expected: The run exits 0; the log has '[2] stopped: it made the same tool call 5 times in a row' followed by a retry of task 2

cases.title: The run page shows the loop stop
steps: Run the same scripted run with --web as TESTING.md describes
Open the URL and look at task 2's card, then click it and open Overview
cases.expected: Task 2's card shows 'loop ×1'; Overview has a 'Loop stops: 1 — the agent was stopped because …' row

cases.title: The final summary lists loop stops
steps: Run the same scripted run in the terminal UI (tmux)
cases.expected: A 'Loop stops:' section with '2: it made the same tool call 5 times in a row: …'

cases.title: A run without loops looks as before
steps: Run the diamond fixture with --provider fake and no script, with --web
Check the cards, a panel's Overview and the final summary
cases.expected: No 'loop ×' badge, no 'Loop stops' row or section
